description: This PHP class implements middleware for compressing request payloads in AWS SDK, handling request compression logic including encoding determination, size validation, and request modification.

classes.name: RequestCompressionMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for compressing AWS SDK request payloads based on operation support and size thresholds.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper function with configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing middleware with handler and configuration.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main method invoked to process and potentially compress the request.

methods.name: compressRequestBody
methods.description: Compresses the request body using determined encoding.

methods.name: determineEncoding
methods.description: Selects encoding method based on available encodings.

methods.name: shouldCompressRequestBody
methods.description: Determines if request body should be compressed based on size, headers, and operation traits.

methods.name: hasStreamingTraitWithoutRequiresLength
methods.description: Checks if operation input has streaming members without length requirement.

methods.name: determineMinimumCompressionSize
methods.description: Calculates minimum compression size from config, supporting callables.

methods.name: isValidCompressionSize
methods.description: Validates compression size is within allowed range.
